provenance: Transcribed from the independent reviewer message; reviewer finished before this report was saved.
findings: Signed operations 0 through 3 and complement-closed paid banks match the checked normalized signed model.
The 120 graph automorphisms preserve the target. Canonical deduplication retains an actual original state and prefix.
Exact live-profile row collisions soundly exclude arbitrary signed continuations.
The stamped collision table handles early returns and uint32 wrap; child collision changes only exclusion timing.
Known L584 and L587 20-gate paths survive signed projection and full collision checks.
All 120 DAG images match row permutation on all 1024 rows.
The phase optimizer algebraically minimizes explicit NOT count for a fixed signed DAG and checks scalar equivalence.
limitations: Native closure is not a Lean proof.
Phase optimum is specific to the supplied DAG and includes dead gates.
A signed binary witness does not by itself establish a total AND/OR/NOT gate count.
This review predates new fast and resume variants; those are not covered here.
